requests.name: asphalt
requests.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless 2D PBR albedo texture for mapping onto real moving 3D geometry in an aviation education simulator.
Primary request: Generate one original 1024x1024 square tileable photorealistic weathered asphalt albedo texture.
Subject: Continuous grey asphalt with fine coarse aggregate, subtle tar wear, a few fine irregular hairline cracks, low contrast weathering and naturally distributed tiny mineral grains. It should read as authentic aged runway or road asphalt at a useful texture scale.
Composition/framing: Strict orthographic directly overhead scan; surface fills every pixel edge to edge, no perspective and no horizon.
Lighting: Perfectly diffuse flat neutral illumination; color information only, no directional light, no cast shadows, no baked ambient shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no illumination gradient.
Constraints: Seamless repeat in both X and Y; matching opposite edges with uniform density so it can tile across a large runway. No distinct central feature or obvious repeating motif. No road markings, text, numbers, arrows, logos, objects, borders, watermark, sphere preview, chart, or mockup. One surface texture only.

requests.name: stone
requests.prompt:

Composition/framing: Strict orthographic directly overhead surface scan; texture fills every pixel edge to edge, no perspective and no horizon.
Lighting: Perfectly diffuse flat neutral illumination; color information only, no directional light, no cast shadows, no baked ambient shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no illumination gradient.
Constraints: Seamless repeat in both X and Y with matching opposite edges, natural uniform feature distribution and no dominant central shape. No vegetation, snow, dramatic dark holes, text, labels, logo, watermark, borders, sphere preview, chart, or mockup. One surface texture only.

requests.name: grass
requests.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless 2D PBR albedo texture for mapping onto real moving 3D terrain geometry in an aviation education simulator.
Primary request: Generate one original 1024x1024 square tileable photorealistic dense dry-green grass and soil albedo texture.
Subject: Dense natural short field grass with small fine olive green and straw colored blades, earth visible only in small scattered patches, subtle random dry-green tonal variation and a realistic organic ground surface. Restrained natural olive and muted straw palette; dense enough to read as a meadow from an aerial view.
Composition/framing: Strict orthographic directly overhead ground scan; surface fills every pixel edge to edge, no perspective and no horizon.
Lighting: Perfectly diffuse flat neutral illumination; color information only, no directional light, no cast shadows, no baked ambient shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no illumination gradient.
Constraints: Seamless repeat in both X and Y with matching opposite edges; even natural density across the tile, no distinct central clump, path, or repeating motif. No flowers, leaves, large rocks, isolated tall plants, text, labels, logo, watermark, borders, sphere preview, chart, or mockup. One surface texture only.
